'''Enlhet''' (Eenlhit), or '''Northern Lengua''', is a language of the Paraguayan [[Gran Chaco|Chaco]], spoken by the northern [[Enxet]] people. It is also known as ''Vowak'' and ''Powok''.

In [[Filadelfia]] (Paraguayan Chaco) there is an organization that advocates for Enlhet language.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://enlhet.org/nne.html |title=Nengvaanemkeskama Nempayvaam Enlhet |accessdate=3 September 2020 |website=Enlhet.org |language=es }}</ref>

== Phonology ==
